meta.name: splunk_ta_sap_logserv_gcp
meta.displayName: Splunk TA for SAP LogServ on GCP

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: GCP Pub/Sub inputs that ingest SAP LogServ objects from Google Cloud Storage via OBJECT_FINALIZE notifications — the GCP counterpart to the AWS SQS-based S3 input. Install on Heavy Forwarders.

entity.label: Input name
entity.help: A unique identifier for this input. Letters, digits, dashes, and underscores only.

validators.errorMsg: Input name must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, dashes, or underscores.

entity.label: Interval (seconds)
entity.help: How often the input polls the subscription (10–3600 seconds). Each firing drains the subscription up to the time budget and the Max objects per fire cap. Default 60 seconds.

validators.errorMsg: Interval must be between 10 and 3600 seconds.

entity.label: GCP project ID
entity.help: The GCP project that hosts the LogServ Pub/Sub subscription (SAP's LogServ project, e.g. from the LOGSERV_PROJECT_ID your SAP support contact provides). 6–30 lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.

validators.errorMsg: Project ID must be 6–30 chars: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, starting with a letter.

entity.label: Subscription name
entity.help: Name of the Pub/Sub PULL subscription that receives the GCS bucket's OBJECT_FINALIZE notifications. Obtain from your SAP support contact; the subscription must be dedicated to this Splunk consumer (competing consumers split messages). Recommended: ack deadline 300s+ and a dead-letter policy.

validators.errorMsg: Subscription name must be 3–255 chars, starting with a letter (letters, digits, and - _ . ~ + %).

entity.label: Service-account key (JSON)
entity.help: Paste the full Google service-account JSON key file. The account needs roles/pubsub.subscriber on the subscription and roles/storage.objectViewer on the LogServ bucket. Stored encrypted in passwords.conf. On Edit the field shows '******'; saving without changing it preserves the existing key.

validators.errorMsg: Paste the complete service-account JSON key (up to 16 KB).

entity.label: Target index
entity.help: Splunk index the ingested events are written to. Defaults to sap_logserv_logs (the index the LogServ dashboards read).

validators.errorMsg: Index name must start with a lowercase letter or digit and contain only lowercase letters, digits, dashes, or underscores.

entity.label: Sourcetype
entity.help: Fixed at sap_logserv_logs. The add-on HARD-CODES this sourcetype (it is NOT read from the input stanza), since the Data TA's index-time routing / Filters / cloud_provider+splunk_solution stamping all key on it. Shown read-only (disabled when editing an existing input); leave it as sap_logserv_logs.

validators.errorMsg: Sourcetype must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, colons, dots, dashes, or underscores.

entity.label: Messages per pull
entity.help: How many Pub/Sub messages to request per pull call (maxMessages; the service caps this at 1000). Default 10.

validators.errorMsg: Messages per pull must be between 1 and 1000.

entity.label: Max objects per fire
entity.help: Safety cap on objects ingested per firing, bounding burst load during backlog drain. The input also stops at a per-firing time budget. Range 1–100000. Default 500.

validators.errorMsg: Max objects per fire must be between 1 and 100000.

entity.label: Poison threshold
entity.help: A message redelivered more than this many times (Pub/Sub deliveryAttempt — reported when the subscription has a dead-letter policy) is acked and dropped so a permanently-bad object can't loop forever. With a dead-letter policy Pub/Sub also dead-letters natively; this is a local backstop. Range 1–100. Default 5.

validators.errorMsg: Poison threshold must be between 1 and 100.

entity.label: Include filters
entity.help: Optional comma-separated substrings applied to the GCS object path as a cheap pre-filter — only objects whose path contains at least one substring are downloaded. Leave empty to accept all LogServ objects. The canonical clz_dir/clz_subdir allow/deny policy lives in the Data TA Filters tab; this only avoids downloading obviously-irrelevant objects.

validators.errorMsg: Include filters must be less than 4096 characters.

entity.label: Exclude filters
entity.help: Optional comma-separated substrings applied to the GCS object path; an object whose path matches any of these is skipped (not downloaded). Exclude always wins over include.

validators.errorMsg: Exclude filters must be less than 4096 characters.

entity.label: Verify SSL
entity.help: Verify the TLS certificates of the Google API endpoints. Leave enabled for production (Google uses valid public certificates).
